description: The components scope of Multi-brand: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: components.roles
answers.why: Product teams build sign-up and account forms, plus product pages with questions and faces.

answers.question: components.count
answers.why: Three product teams find their next parts ready, kept by one platform team.

answers.question: components.definition
answers.why: Product teams find a whole family ready instead of asking one by one.

answers.question: components.values
answers.why: Variants for emphasis and size let each brand feel present without new components.

answers.question: components.lands
answers.why: Most components sit in sign-up and account pages.

usage.use: a component from the inventory with brand tokens
usage.not: a component made for one brand
usage.why: Brands change primitives, never components; one brand-only part breaks the shared library.
